text.S1: Once upon a time there were four little Rabbits, and their names were— Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter.
text.T1: Kale kale muciindi Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail ankinga Petuto
text.T2: Kuciindi cimwi kwakali twana twa sulwe tone, amazina antuto akali—Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, aa Peter.

text.S1: They lived with their Mother in a sand-bank, underneath the root of a very big fir- tree.
text.T1: Twakali kukkala munkomwe yamuseenga, kunsi a muyanda wacisamu camukuyu abanyina
text.T2: Twakali kukkala abanyina munkomwe yamuseenga, kunsi amuyanda wacisamu ca Mukuyu.

text.S1: 'Now my dears,' said old Mrs. Rabbit one morning, 'you may go into the fields or down the lane, but don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden: your Father had an accident there; he was put in a pie by Mrs. McGregor.'
text.T1: “Nobayandwa bangu,” bakaamba banyina cifumofumo bumwi buzuba, “inga mwainka munyuunda nokuba munzila pele mutakabi nomuya kunjila mumbewu ya munene McGregor nkaambo bauso bakalijanide muntenda ookuya bakababikka mucimkwa canyama bamuka McGregor.”
text.T2: ‘Lino Nobayandwa bangu,’ bakaamba bacembele ba muka Sulwe cifumofumo Bumwi buzuba, ‘inga mwainka mumyuunda naa munzila, pele mutakabi nomuya kunjila mumbeu ya munene McGregor: bauso bakalijanikide muntenda ookuya; bakababikka mucinkwa kuli ba muka McGregor.’

text.S1: “Now run along, and don't get into mischief. I am going out.”
text.T1: “Lino kamuzuza kamuboola, mutabi nomuyoolijana mumakani mabi ndainka mebo”.
text.T2: “Lino kamuzuza kamuboola, mutabi nomuyoolijana mumakani mabi. Ndaunka mebo”.

text.S1: Then old Mrs. Rabbit took a basket and her umbrella, and went through the wood to the baker's. She bought a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
text.T1: aalya bacembele bakaintu ba Sulwe bakanyamuna kanzuma akaluli kazuba akwiinda musaka kuya kubambilwa cinkwa.Okuya bakaula cinkwa azimbuwa zyosamwe.
text.T2: Mpoona bacembele bamuka Sulwe bakanyamuna kanzuma akaluli kabo Kakwabilila izuba, akwiinda mumasaka kuya kubambilwa cinkwa.

text.S1: Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail, who were good little bunnies, went down the lane to gather blackberries:
text.T1: Flopsy, Mopsy alimwi a Cotton-tail, itwakali twana twasulwe tubotu twakaya kukubwezelela masaansa asiya.
text.T2: Flopsy, mopsy alimwi aa Cotton-tail, itwakali twana twasulwetubotu twakaya kukubwezelela masaansa aasiya.

text.S1: But Peter, who was very naughty, ran straight away to Mr. McGregor's garden, and squeezed under the gate!
text.T1: Pele Petulo wakali kusunda, walo wakatijila kumbewu ya munene McGregor ngooyo walyaatikizya kunsi lya geedi!
text.T2: Pele Petulo wakali kusunda, wakatijila kumbeu ya munene McGregor, akulyaatikizya kunsi lya mulyanago wa munzi!

text.S1: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans; and then he ate some radishes;
text.T1: Cakutaanguna wakatalika kulya cisyu ca letesi anyabo mpoona ngooyo waya kukulya tumwi ntobanti tuma ladisyi.
text.T2: Cakutaanguna wakatalika kulya cisyu ca letesi anyabo; mpoona wakalya miyanda iikozyanya acimbwali iitegwa ma ladishes;

text.S1: And then, feeling rather sick, he went to look for some parsley.
text.T1: nokwakamana waawo, kalinvwide kuciwa, Petulo wakaya kukuyandaula pasili.
text.T2: Alimwi mpoona, kalimvide kuciswa, wakaya kuyandaula pasili.

text.S1: But round the end of a cucumber frame, whom should he meet but Mr. McGregor!
text.T1: Pele kuzinguluka biyo munda wamakowa, nguni ngwaya kuswaanya kuya? pele munene McGregor!Ba McGregor bakali kufugeme amaanza amagondo ansi.
text.T2: Pele kuzinguluka biyo munda wamakowa, nguni ngwaya kuswaanya kuya pele munene McGregor!

text.S1: Mr. McGregor was on his hands and knees planting out young cabbages, but he jumped up and ran after Peter, waving a rake and calling out, 'Stop thief!'
text.T1: Ba McGregor bakali kufugeme amaanza amagondo ansi kabaya kusyanga tukkabicci tuniini, mpoona bakavundumuka akutandaanya Petulo, anhala kumaanza akoongolola kuti “ima yebo omubbi”.
text.T2: Ba McGregor bakali fugeme amaanza amaggongdo aansi kabayaabusyanga tukkabici tuniini, pele bakavundumuka akutandaanya Petulo, anhala kumaanza akoongolola kuti, ‘Leka omubbi!’

text.S1: Peter was most dreadfully frightened; he rushed all over the garden, for he had forgotten the way back to the gate. He lost one of his shoes among the cabbages, and the other shoe amongst the potatoes.
text.T1: Petulo wakayoowa calufu; wakatijaana mbewu yoonse, nkaambo wakakuluba kwakunjila.Bbusu lyakwe lyomwe lyakaswekela akati kamakkabicci, limwi lyakasweekela mucimbwali.
text.T2: Petulo wakayoowa calufu; wakatijaana mbewu yoonse, nkaambo wakakuluba kwakunjilila. Bbusu lyakwe lyomwe lyakaswekela akati kamakkabicci, limwi lyakasweekela mucimbwali.

text.S1: After losing them, he ran on four legs and went faster, so that I think he might have got away altogether if he had not unfortunately run into a gooseberry net, and got caught by the large buttons on his jacket. It was a blue jacket with brass buttons, quite new.
text.T1: Naakama kusweesya mabbusu, wakatalika kutija amaulu one a kubinda kapati cakuti ndiyeeyela kuti naakakonzya kutijila lyo pele kubula coolwe wakoobwa mulutabitabi lwa michelo akugobwa kunkopela ya cibaki cakwe.Cibaki cakwe cakali camubala wajulu ankopela zyalubulo, cipya.
text.T2: Naakamana kusweesya mabbusu, wakatalika kulunduka amaulu one akubinda kapati, ndiyeeyela kuti kuti naakakonzya kutijila lyo pele kubula coolwe wakoobwa mututabitabi lwa michelo akugobwa kunkopela ya cibaki cakwe. Cibaki cakwe cakalicamubala wajulu ankopela zyalubulo, cipya.

text.S1: Peter gave himself up for lost, and shed big tears; but his sobs were overheard by some friendly sparrows, who flew to him in great excitement, and implored him to exert himself.
text.T1: Petulo wakasweeka kapati, akulila amisozi minji mpoona tutiiti twaluse twakamumvwa, twakaulukila kuli nguwe mukukkomana akumukulwaizya kuti abelesya busongo
text.T2: Petulo wakasweeka kapati, akulosya misozi minji; pele kulila kwakwe kwakamvugwa atutiiti twaluse, twakaulukila kuli nguwe mukukkomana, akumukulwaizya kuti abelesye busongo.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor came up with a sieve, which he intended to pop upon the top of Peter; but Peter wriggled out just in time, leaving his jacket behind him.
text.T1: Munene McGregor wakasika ansefa, njaakali kuti abikke atala lya Petulo, pesi Petulo wakalikwela mukaindi kaniini akusiya cibaki cakwe munsi.
text.T2: Munene McGregor wakasika ansefwa, njaakali kuti abike atala lya Petulo; pele Petulo waklikwela mukaindi kaniini, akusiya cibaki cakwe munsi.

text.S1: And rushed into the tool-shed, and jumped into a can. It would have been a beautiful thing to hide in, if it had not had so much water in it.
text.T1: Wakatijila mukaanda muyobwedwa zibelesyo akunjila mukagabba.Omu noonga wakayuba kabotu biya kuti nomwataali meenda manji.
text.T2: Wakatijila mukaanda muyobwedwa zibelesyo, akusotokela mukaggabba. Oomu noonga wakayuba kabotu, kuti nomwatakali meenda manji mukati.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor was quite sure that Peter was somewhere in the tool-shed, perhaps hidden underneath a flower-pot. He began to turn them over carefully, looking under each. Presently Peter sneezed—'Kertyschoo!' Mr. McGregor was after him in no time.
text.T1: Ba McGregor taaku nibakazumbauzya pe kuti Petulo wakali mung’anda yazibelesyo, ndiza wakayubide kunsi acipika camaluba.Bakatalika kupindamuna kabotu – kabotu, kabalanga kunsi kwa comwe-acomwe.Aawa mpoona Petulo wakeetyemuka “Ketisyoo”.McGregor wakamutandila cakutwaamba.
text.T2: Ba McGregor bakali syomede kapati kuti Petulo wakali mung’anda yazibelesyo,ndiza wakayubide kunsi aacipika camaluba. Wakatalika kuzipindamuna kabotu-kabotu, akulangalanga kunsi kwa comwe-comwe. Aawa mpoona Petulo wakaesyemuka ‘Ketsyoo!’. McGregor wakamutandila cakufwambaana.

text.S1: And tried to put his foot upon Peter, who jumped out of a window, upsetting three plants. The window was too small for Mr. McGregor, and he was tired of running after Peter. He went back to his work.
text.T1: wakasoleka kulyata Petulo, walo wakasotokela ampulungwido akuunsya tusamu totatwe.Mpulugwido yakalisyoonto kuti McGregor inga weela, mpoona wakakatala kutandaanya Petulo.Mpawo wakajokelela ncito yakwe.
text.T2: Akusola kusola kulyata Petulo, walo wakasotokela ampulungwido, akuunsya tusamu totatwe. Imulungwido yakali isyoonto kuli McGregor, alimwi wakakatala kutandaanya Petulo. Mpaawo wakajokelela ncito yakwe.

text.S1: Peter sat down to rest; he was out of breath and trembling with fright, and he had not the least idea which way to go. Also he was very damp with sitting in that can. After a time he began to wander about, going lippity—lippity—not very fast, and looking all round.
text.T1: Petulo wakakkala kulyookezya, wakakatala citaambiki kabimba cakuyoowa katazyi akwakugama.Alimmi wakalitetede akaambo kakukkala mucigabba.Nikwakainda kaindi wakatalika kweendauka cakubulilwa nzila, kweenda zinzilio-zinzili- cakutabinda kalangalanga ooku koonse-koonse.
text.T2: Petulo wakakkala aansi akulyookezya, wakakatala citaambiki kabimba cakutoowa, alimwi taakazyi akwakugama. Alimwi wakali tetede akaambo kakukkala mucigabba. Nikwakainda kaindi wakatalika kwendauka, kweenda zinzilio-zinzili-cakutabinda, kalangalanga koonse-koonse.

text.S1: He found a door in a wall; but it was locked, and there was no room for a fat little rabbit to squeeze underneath. An old mouse was running in and out over the stone doorstep, carrying peas and beans to her family in the wood. Peter asked her the way to the gate, but she had such a large pea in her mouth that she could not answer. She only shook her head at him. Peter began to cry.
text.T1: Wakajana mulyango kubwaanda, pele wakali kkiidwe alimwi biya kwakanyina abusena bweela cana ca sulwe cineneede kuti cilisinikizye kunsi.Mbeba ncenbele yakali kutijaana kainjila akuzwa amulyango waabambidwe amabwe kaibweza mbwiila anyabo kutolela mukwasyi wayo muzipako zyazisamu zyanganda.Petulo wakaibuzya mbeba bwakuya kuzwidwa aanze, pele yakajisi mbwiila mpati kumulomo wayo elyo tiyakakonzya kuvwiila.Yakailekuzungaanya mutwe kuli nguwe.Petulo wakatalika kulila.
text.T2: Wakajana mulyango kubwaanda; pele wakali kkiiddwe, alimwi biya kwakanyina abusenabweela cana ca sulwe cineneedekuti cili sinikizye kunsi. Imbeba ncembele yakali kutijaana kainjila akuzwa amulyango waabambidwe aamabwe, kaibweza mbwiila anyabo kutolela mukwasyi wayo muzipako zya zisamu zya ng’anda. Petulo wakaibuzya mbeba kwakwiinda kuzwida aanze, pele yakajisi mbwiila mpati kumulomo wayo icakapa kuti ikakilwe kuvwiila. Yakaile kuzungaanya mutwe kukuli nguwe. Petulo wakatalika kulila.

text.S1: Then he tried to find his way straight across the garden, but he became more and more puzzled. Presently, he came to a pond where Mr. McGregor filled his water- cans. A white cat was staring at some gold-fish. She sat very, very still, but now and then the tip of her tail twitched as if it were alive. Peter thought it best to go away without speaking to her; he had heard about cats from his cousin, little Benjamin Bunny.
text.T1: Mpoonya wakatalika kuya buyandaula nzila yakwe kagama mu mbewu pesi – eeci cakamuletela kupyopyongana kwiinda.Kwaciindi ncoona eeci, wakalijana kuciziba cameenda McGregor nkwaali kuzuzya zigabba ameenda. Kaaze utuba wakali kulangilila nswi yangolide.Wakalikkede zii cakutaputauka, pesi kacila kakwe kakumamanino kakanuka nuka mbuli kuti kakali kupona.Petulo wakayeeya kwiindilila kakunyina kumukananzya mangoye; wakamvwa twaambo tunji kuzwa kumweeninyina Benjamin Bunny tuguminizya kaaze.
text.T2: Mpoonya wakatalika kuya buyandaula nzila yakwe kagama mu mbeu, pele eeci cakamuletela kupyopyongana kwiinda. Kwaciindi ncoona eeci, wakalijana kuciziba cameenda nkobakali kutekameenda akuzuzya ziggabba ba McGregor. Ikakkiti katubakakali kulanga nswi ya ngolide. Wakalikkede zii cakutaputauka, pesi kacila kankkako kakumamanino kakali kungaana mbuli kuti kakali kupona. Petulo wakayeeya kwiindilila kakunyina kukakanazya; wkamvwa twaambo tunji kuzwa kumweeninyina, Benjamin Bunny.

text.S1: He went back towards the tool-shed, but suddenly, quite close to him, he heard the noise of a hoe—scr-r-ritch, scratch, scratch, scritch. Peter scuttered underneath the bushes. But presently, as nothing happened, he came out, and climbed upon a wheelbarrow and peeped over. The first thing he saw was Mr. McGregor hoeing onions. His back was turned towards Peter, and beyond him was the gate!
text.T1: Wakajokela kaya kung’anda yazibelesyo, pele mpoona mpoona munsi munsi lyakwe, wakamvwa jamba kaliti-kweepu, -kwepu, kwepu kwepu. Petulo wakakwipuka kweendesya akayuba musokwe pele kwaceeci ciindi kwiina cakacitika pe wakaile wakazwa akukkwela atala lya wilibbala akusondela. Cakusoka ncaakabona wakali McGregor kalimina hanyisi. Sule lyakwe munene wakalipede Petulo, kumbele kakulibonya geedi yakuzwida.
text.T2: Wakajokela kuya kung’anda ya zibelesyo, pele mpoona mpoona, munsi munsi lyakwe, wakamvwa kusabila kwajamba kaliti-kkwepu, kkwepu kkwepu. Petulo wakakwipuka kweendesya akuyuba musokwe muzitewu. Pele kwaceeci ciindi kwiina cakacitika pe, wakaile kuzwa akukkwela atala lya wilibbala akusondela. Cakusaanguna ncaakabona wakali munene McGregor kalimina hanyisi. Sule lyakwe wakalipede Petulo, mpoona kumbele kwakwe kwaklibonya geedi yakuzwida.

text.S1: Peter got down very quietly off the wheelbarrow; and started run- ning as fast as he could go, along a straight walk behind some black- currant bushes. Mr. McGregor caught sight of him at the corner, but Peter did not care. He slipped underneath the gate, and was safe at last in the wood outside the garden.
text.T1: Petulo wakaseluka kuzwa awilibbala kakunyina kusokoma pe akulubikka lubilo luyumu nta mukazila kazisamu zyakasokwe kakasyangidwe misaansa yama gileepu. McGregor wakamukwensya buyo kumubona kanyona, pele Petulo taakakombelela kuli boobu wakazwida ansi a geedi, wakalunduka ngooyo anze ambewu.
text.T2: Petulo wakaseluka kuzwa awilibbala kakunyina kusokoma pe akulubikka lubilo luyumu nta, mukazila ka zisamu zyakasokwe kakasyangidwe misaansa yama gileepu. McGregor wakamukwensya buyo kumubona kanyona, pele Petulo taakakombbelela . wakainda aansi ya geedi, wakalunduka ngooyo anze ambewu.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor hung up the little jacket and the shoes for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.
text.T1: Munene McGregor wakaanzika kabaki amabbusu kubamba cikonga bana cakuyoosya bayumi.
text.T2: Munene McGregor wakaanzika kabaki amabbusu kubamba cikonga bana cakuyoosya bayuni.

text.S1: Peter never stopped running or looked behind him till he got home to the big fir-tree.
text.T1: Petulo kwiina naakaleka kulunduka nokuba kuceba mpaka ngooyo waakusika kumunzi mucisamu cipati camukuyu kumizyaabo.
text.T2: Petulo kwiina naakaleka kulunduka nokuba kuceba mpaka ngooyo wakusika kumunzi mucisamu cipati camukuyu kumiziyaabo.

text.S1: He was so tired that he flopped down upon the nice soft sand on the floor of the rabbit-hole and shut his eyes. His mother was busy cooking; she wondered what he had done with his clothes. It was the second little jacket and pair of shoes that Peter had lost in a fort-night!
text.T1: Wakalema cakuti wakaile kuwa amusenga muteetete ansi mukaanda katusulwe akujala meso akwe. Banyina bakali kukutauka kujika; bakanyandwa kuti naa zikobela zyakwe wakazityani. Cakali ciindi cabili eeci Petulo kusweesya zyakusama mumvwiki zyobilo zyainda.
text.T2: Wakalema cakuti wakaile kuwa amusenga muteteete ansi mukaanda katusulwe akujala meso akwe. Banyina bakali kukutauka kujika; bakanyandwa kuti naa zikobela zyakwe wakazityani. Cakali ciindi cabili eeci Petulo ncaakasweesya zyakusama mumvwiki zyobilo zyainda.

text.S1: I am sorry to say that Peter was not very well during the evening.
text.T1: Ndausa kwaamba kuti Petulo taakaliswiilide kabotu mangolezya conse buzuba boonse.
text.T2: Ndausa kwaamba kuti Petulo taakaliswiilide kabotu mangolezya oonse.

text.S1: His mother put him to bed, and made some camomile tea; and she gave a dose of it to Peter! 'One table-spoonful to be taken at bed-time.'
text.T1: Banyina Petulo bakamooneka abulo, akumubambila meenda a tii wamusamu wakanywa mumuungo wakulisya kuti kanywa kaindi komwe aciindi cakooma masiku.
text.T2: Banyina bakamooneka abulo, akumubambila meenda aa tii wamusamu; akumupa Petulo mumuungo kuti anywe! ‘imuungo omwe uuzwide kuti kanywa aciindi cakoona masiku.

text.S1: But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper.
text.T1: Pele Flopsy, Mopsy aCotton-tail bakalya icinkwa amukupa amasaansa asiya kucilalilo.
text.T2: Pele Flopsy, Mopsy, a Cotton-tail bakalya cinkwa amukupa amasaansa aasiya kucilalilo.

text.S1: THE END
text.T1: KWAMANA
